title: iKnowSpots
tagline: Event Hosting & Ticketing Platform With NFTs & RSVP Escrow To Improve Event Participation
description: We prioritize community leaders and organizers, providing them with user-friendly tools to create, manage, and promote events. We help them to boost their engagements with our ticketing tools and reward systems. Our platform fosters inclusivity, encourages communication, and offers RSVP escrow to boost community engagement. It's about empowering and connecting people in a new era of event hosting.
how_its_made: In our strategy, we're looking to integrate Polygon as our primary layer-2 scaling solution alongside the Ethereum mainnet. This allows us to conduct parallel transactions and operations, with Polygon handling the bulk of our activities. Polygon's faster and more cost-effective transaction processing capabilities make it a suitable choice for executing smart contracts and token transfers. Meanwhile, the Ethereum mainnet remains our anchor, providing essential security and infrastructure for our decentralized applications. This approach strikes a balance between scalability and security within our blockchain ecosystem.
